# StatNerds – Sports Integration Backlog

Alle geplanten Sportarten mit API-Quelle und Ziel-Version.

## API-Provider
| Provider | Key | Sportarten |
|----------|-----|------------|
| [API-Sports](https://api-sports.io) | Gleicher Key wie Football | Fußball, Basketball, Baseball, Tennis, F1, Handball, Hockey, MMA, NFL, Rugby, Volleyball |
| [SportAPI (RapidAPI)](https://rapidapi.com/sportapi) | Separater RapidAPI-Key | Darts, Snooker, Floorball, MotoGP, NASCAR, WRC, Badminton, Tischtennis, Wasserball, Beach-Volleyball, Cricket, Rugby League |
